subtitles.text: The story begins in a small kingdom.
His neighbor, who cares for him, is his best friend.
There's a letter on the table... What might it contain?
[EN] Will ven a verme cuando despiertes.
[EN] Una bola de fuego se dirige hacia ellos.
Will opens his eyes, astonished, not understanding what he has just done.
[EN] Y una bola de fuego sale de sus manos, desviando el proyectil por completo.
[EN] Will está confundido con lo que acaba de pasar cuando de pronto...
The ground trembles and a dark figure emerges amid smoke and fire: a demon.
Eldran shouts: "Will! Use your magic, press X and defeat the demon."
